create_Version_instance: create a Version instance from a version string like '1.0.0' with optional description
compare_Version_objects: compare two Version objects using equality or less-than operators to check version ordering
parse_version_string_to_tuple: parse a version string into a major minor patch tuple using the internal helper function
convert_version_tuple_to_string: convert a version tuple back to a dotted string format like '2.1.3'
create_Version_from_dict: create a Version instance from a dictionary containing version string and description fields
